w2:textbox.label: Move Row via Dragging while Maintaining Row Status

1. Click the deleteRow(2) button at the bottom.
2. Confirm that the row with index="2" in both the first GridView and the second GridView is deleted.

(Within the first GridView)
3. Confirm that the row status remains “Deleted” when navigating to the deleted row.

(Within the second GridView)
3. Confirm that the row status changes from “Deleted” to “Added” when navigating to the deleted row.
